I would like to have a numeric input item besides analog bar.
I don't want to have trouble getting back to the previous settings.
@{5baa1068e0b68928323f5213|full_name}: Settings in general are very lacking.
Yet another feature custom clients have and us vanilla users cannot use because someone paid a salary can't get as much work done as someone who does it in their free time.

"when most games have it from day one."
You do know that this game is still in early access, right? It technically isn't fully released yet so what "Day one" are we talking about?
@{5d6ac3d319a45a329c545086|full_name}: VRC was released February 1, 2017 quit using early access as an excuse for lack of basic functionality
@{5d6421f54e8b1c464ccbb0f8|full_name}: early access kind of implies lack of functionality, doesn't it?

You mentioned Discord.
I would appreciate having something like the Mic indicator you see to the bottom left within the menu as well. So that we test and figure out where to put our slider.

Other canny posts that should merge into this one: 
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/mic-input-sensitivity-disable-auto-detection
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/microphone-input-sensitivity
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/microphone-sensitivity-1
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/mic-sensitivity-settings
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/suggestion-always-on-mic-sensitivity
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/voice-settings

This would be great for the folk who play music through their mic in-game, considering the audio cutoff can kill quiet or low notes and sounds. It would also be generally beneficial to people who want to have their mic sensitivity set higher or lower for certain reasons like noise control.

details: We need better settings for Microphones instead of just a volume slider. There's no good noise cancellation which causes my own mic to sound static-y and echo-y even though on programs like Discord I sound perfectly fine! A mic sensitivity slider would also be very useful and it's mind-boggling why it's not in the game yet when most games have it from day one. Please fix this!
title: Better Mic Settings!
